checkpoints: After each edit, the draft is pending rather than immediately persisted.
At 120 ms after the most recent edit for that document, exactly the latest pending text is written.
After navigation or close, any already-pending per-document save remains associated with its originating document.
Search preview still uses its existing 40 ms trailing task and cancellation behavior.
Ruby syntax remains valid under the declared Ruby 2.7.0 runtime.
forbidden_effects: Do not write to the store on every editor edit.
Do not save superseded intermediate text from the same burst.
Do not attach a pending draft to whichever document happens to be selected when the timer fires.
Do not alter search preview timing or behavior.
Do not combine document body, per-document buffer, and navigation outline responsibilities.
Do not weaken synchronous navigation, selection, projection, subscription, or persistence behavior beyond the requested autosave change.
lifecycle_identity: Each pending autosave belongs to the document identifier whose editor buffer received the edit.
The existing BufferBank retains one Trailing autosave task per document identifier.
A visit identifies navigation/display state; it must not replace document identity for persistence.
A committed projection trail contains copied visit records rather than aliases to mutable caller data.

obligations.text: Editor autosave must coalesce a burst of edits and persist only the latest text after 120 ms without another edit.
The autosave implementation should reuse the existing Trailing utility and the existing per-document BufferBank where appropriate.
Pending saves must remain scoped to their originating document so navigation does not redirect a draft save to another document.
Workspace navigation, selection, close, projection trail, and persistence behavior must otherwise remain unchanged.
Store writes must continue to synchronously notify active saved integrations.
Search preview behavior, including its existing 40 ms trailing timing and hide cancellation, must remain unchanged.

ordering_barriers: A new edit for the same document cancels the prior timer before scheduling a new 120 ms timer.
The latest pending text is captured before the trailing task is scheduled; persistence occurs only when that task flushes.
A store write updates the record and revision before synchronously invoking currently active listeners.
Document retirement detaches its store listener before emitting the nil document output.
Opening a document retires the prior document before creating and publishing the new document badge.
Selection opens/publishes the document before committing the corresponding projection visit in the ordinary non-reentrant path.
Closing retires the document before clearing the projection in the ordinary non-reentrant path.
preservation: Workspace continues to expose select(id), edit(text), close(), selection(), and dispose().
Selecting a document continues to publish its stored body with its document id and visit id.
Closing continues to clear the active document and projection selection.
Projection continues to retain a copied breadcrumb archive of committed visits.
Store reads continue to return copied frozen text, and writes continue to persist copied frozen text with increasing revisions.
Saved integrations continue to be notified synchronously and may navigate during callbacks.
A pending autosave survives ordinary navigation because buffers are maintained per document; the task does not require canceling drafts on document retirement.
Search preview remains an adjacent transient consumer with its independent 40 ms trailing task.
scope: Change business code only in src/workflow.rb as needed to implement editor autosave coalescing.
The maintenance scope is editor draft persistence through the workspace store.
Navigation and outline/projection are preservation scope, not redesign scope.
Search preview is explicitly outside the change scope.

def get(env,id);@entries[id] ||= Trailing.new(env,120) {|text| env.write(id,text)};end
def edit(text);view=@current;@env.write(view.id,text) if view;end
@listeners.to_a.each { |token, block| block.call(event) if @listeners.key?(token) }
def initialize(env);@task=Trailing.new(env,40){|q| env.output('preview',{'query'=>q})};end
def hide;@task.cancel;end
def commit(v);@selected=v.dup;@trail<<v.dup;publish;end
